title: Chapter 283 The Power Of The Demonic Wolf
content:
Chapter 283 The Power Of The Demonic Wolf

Good saw the extraordinary nature of this ice and fire demon wolf.

The "Eagle Eye" skill was activated, and three arrows were shot out immediately.

"Three Stars in a Row"

Wang Shuo suffered a lot from this skill.

However, the Demon Wolf King swished away the two arrows with two swipes.

The third arrow hit him, but it only took away less than 200 health points.

Good's heart trembled, but he had no time to think about it, so he had to ride away to one side.

At this time, the huge body of the Demon Wolf King appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo swallowed hard.

He was panicked inexplicably.

When confronting Toad Brunei, Wang Shuo was ready to die.

But at this time, he had a large army in his hands, and he didn't want to fail again.

Instead, he was afraid.

The appearance of the Demon Wolf King shocked Ayub and others, which was different from the original intelligence.

[Ice and Fire Demon Wolf King (Primary Warlord)]

[Level: Level 45]

[Attack Power: 2000]

[Defense Power: 1200]

[HP: 30000]

[Skills: War Wolf Fang, Demon Wolf Howling Sun, Ice and Fire, Bloodthirsty Bite. ]

When Wang Shuo saw the attributes of the Demon Wolf King, he suddenly felt a headache.

As far as Wang Shuo knew, the levels of generals were primary generals, intermediate generals, advanced generals, top generals, and then warlords.

It was 3 levels higher.

And the three high attributes were also somewhat despairing.

Especially the defense, ordinary soldiers basically had no chance of breaking through the defense.

Even for Wang Shuo, it was difficult to break through the defense with ordinary attacks.

And the low level showed that this demon wolf had great potential.

Wang Shuo quickly adjusted his breathing. As the main general, he must not show weakness, otherwise the low morale would inevitably lead to the defeat of the army.

After calming down, Wang Shuo decided to deal with these skeleton soldiers first.

Although they were skeleton infantry, they were all high-level infantry, which was fundamentally different from the skeleton soldiers in the ancient battlefield.

But thinking back to the skeleton soldiers who attacked Black Dragon City, they were still much weaker.

Seeing these soldiers who once fought against the undead, now they have become undead, and the Black Dragon King has also become undead.

It really has the taste of "dragon slayer warriors, but eventually become evil dragons".

The golden fire cavalry quickly broke through the enemy's scattered formation and knocked away countless skeleton soldiers.

The three dog heads of the Hell Knights bit the skeleton soldiers' bones, tore them hard, and threw them aside.

The battlefield was very chaotic.

Some high-level undead kicked hard, threw the cavalry on the warhorse to the ground, and wrestled.

Although this round of charge killed through the camp of the skeleton army, it also lost more than ten people.

Even the three-headed dog was killed by the Demon Wolf King.

Wang Shuo's heart sank. This was war. He might also die.

All around, the archers kept circling around, surrounding the battlefield and firing harassing shots.

Arrows flew everywhere. Many skeletons had the upper hand, but they were interrupted by the sudden attack of arrows, which led to them being knocked down or even killed by their opponents.

The second charge was launched again with the sound of war drums.

After a round of fierce fighting, Wang Shuo's fear of death became very calm.

Facing these dead spirits with flaming bodies.

Wang Shuo calmly raised the Bloodthirsty Spear, stabbed it hard, picked up a skeleton soldier, and rushed into the battlefield.

Facing the invincible Demon Wolf King, Wang Shuo had a countermeasure.

He led the three major corps, plowed through the skeleton corps, and headed straight for Nanshanji.

It looked like a hasty escape.

At this time, there were not many skeleton soldiers who could still stand, less than 300.

Wang Shuo's three armies also lost more than 400 people. The battle was extremely brutal.

Seeing Wang Shuo and others leave.

The Demon Wolf King ordered Takker to pursue.

And he himself jumped out and chased after them.
